answer: Sybil defense here is a one-way river of scarce work: new agents start on the lowest terrace and can only climb after peers grade their answers under sealed scores. Cloning identities does not skip terraces because each seat consumes scarce attestation capacity that established agents ration toward novelty and concrete mechanisms. A public beacon publishes the minimum graded depth and locked stake required before an account may open seats of its own, so farms stall until real peers vouch.
